-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [CicloDeFacturacion] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_CicloDeFacturacion_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @CicloDeFacturacionFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		CicloDeFacturacion_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @CicloDeFacturacionFilter (CicloDeFacturacion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[CicloDeFacturacion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[CicloDeFacturacion]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[CicloDeFacturacion].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @CicloDeFacturacionFilter (CicloDeFacturacion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[CicloDeFacturacion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[CicloDeFacturacion]

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[CicloDeFacturacion].[Id],
		dbo.fnObtenerDescripcionMes([CicloDeFacturacion].[Mes]) + ' ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), [CicloDeFacturacion].[Anio]) AS [Nombre],		
		[CicloDeFacturacion].[FechaDeGeneracion] AS [FechaDeGeneracion_UTCT],						
		[dbo].[TipoProcesoEjecucion].[Nombre] AS [UltimaEjecucion],
		[Ejecucion].[FechaInicial] AS [FechaEjecucion_UTCT],
		[Ejecucion].[EstatusProceso] AS [Estatus],
		[CicloDeFacturacion].[Vigente]
	FROM @CicloDeFacturacionFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[CicloDeFacturacion] 
			ON [CicloDeFacturacion].[Id] = filter.[CicloDeFacturacion_Id] 
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Ejecucion] ON [dbo].[CicloDeFacturacion].[UltimaEjecucion_Id] = [dbo].[Ejecucion].[Id]
		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[TipoProcesoEjecucion] ON [dbo].[Ejecucion].[TipoProcesoEjecucion_Id] = [dbo].[TipoProcesoEjecucion].[Id]
END
